clauses.quote: DCPS shall make available to the WTU, in a timely manner, unedited copies of all documents relevant to grievance cases that are not protected from disclosure by law.
DCPS shall offer training on the School budgeting process to all LSAT Teachers.
All official announcements to teachers and other information of interest to teachers shall be posted upon receipt by the Supervisor on the school’s main office bulletin boards for review by teachers.
clauses.subject_text: All official announcements to teachers and other information of interest to teachers

clauses.quote: Simultaneously, a copy will be provided to the Building Representative.
When such announcement contains compliance deadlines, or where timelines are a factor in the content of the announcement, copies shall be distributed to all teachers.
A copy of the current teaching and non-teaching assignments and the per-period class coverage rotation list will be posted on the school’s main office bulletin board in each school by October 1st.
clauses.subject_text: A copy of the current teaching and non-teaching assignments and the per-period class coverage rotation list

clauses.quote: Changes resulting from the addition, deletion or reorganization of teachers in a building will be posted promptly.
clauses.subject_text: Changes resulting from the addition, deletion or reorganization of teachers in a building

clauses.quote: A copy will be furnished to the Building Representative within two school days of any change.
A current copy of a comprehensive staff roster, the school building seniority list, and full information concerning regular and extra-duty assignments shall be made available upon request.
clauses.subject_text: A current copy of a comprehensive staff roster, the school building seniority list, and full information concerning regular and extra-duty assignments

clauses.quote: The seniority list shall contain the name of the Teacher, the date of entry into the school, the number of years of building seniority, and the date of certification.
A copy of the DCMR and the Chancellor’s Directives shall be maintained in the school business office and shall be available for use by teachers and the WTU Building Representative.
clauses.subject_text: A copy of the DCMR and the Chancellor’s Directives

clauses.quote: A current copy of the Local School Plan, including an up-to-date school budget, shall be maintained in the school library and the main office at all times for review by teachers.
clauses.subject_text: A current copy of the Local School Plan, including an up-to-date school budget

clauses.quote: Teachers shall be provided a copy or allowed to make a copy upon request.
The Supervisor shall inform the Building Representative of proposed changes to the Local School Plan and budgetary spending priorities before making them.
